name: ISZE — PRISM analytics
install: python3 -m pip install --user --upgrade pip && python3 -m pip install --user -r 03_analytics/Isuzu/prism/requirements.txt pytest

terminals.name: PRISM (Streamlit)
terminals.command: cd 03_analytics/Isuzu/prism && python3 -m streamlit run app.py --server.port 8503 --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.headless true --browser.gatherUsageStats false
terminals.description: PRISM — Parts Revenue Intelligence & Sales Monitor dashboard. Serves on http://localhost:8503. Reads committed derived data from 01_data/00_derived/. Run PRISM unit tests with: cd 03_analytics/Isuzu/prism && python3 -m pytest tests/ -q
